description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderFactory class, verifying its ability to create appropriate DataReader objects based on version information, including tests for unknown, version 1, and version 2 data readers.

classes.name: DataReaderFactoryTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing DataReaderFactory creation methods.

methods.name: shouldFailToCreateDataReaderForUnknownVersion
methods.description: Test that creating a data reader with an unknown version (23) returns nullptr.

methods.name: shouldCreateDataReaderV1
methods.description: Test that creating a data reader with version 1 returns a DataReaderV1 instance.

methods.name: shouldCreateDataReaderV2
methods.description: Test that creating a data reader with version 2 returns a DataReaderV2 instance.
